subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella while maintainers split implementation into a TTS Read aloud slice and a separate editable provider-backed dictation slice?
rationale: Current main has reusable primitives but no complete product flow, and the STT recorder semantics, privacy boundary, and open partial PRs require maintainer direction before automation should attempt a new fix.

options.title: Split TTS and dictation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, review a narrow secure Read aloud PR, and review editable dictation through tools.media.audio under its narrower issue.

options.title: Unify under Talk
options.body: Treat Talk/transcription-only sessions as the single future voice surface, but accept that this changes the requested editable push-to-talk workflow.

options.title: Defer WebChat voice
options.body: Leave only file upload and Talk for now, and close or pause partial PRs until the WebChat voice product direction is re-scoped.

recommendation.title: Split TTS and dictation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, review a narrow secure Read aloud PR, and review editable dictation through tools.media.audio under its narrower issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the open Read aloud candidate and authored prior server-side WebChat dictation work in this area.
